severe_hypoglycemia_exclusion.clause_text: Have a documented history of severe hypoglycemia (defined as an event requiring third-party assistance for recovery) within 6 months prior to screening, OR more than 2 episodes of severe hypoglycemia within the prior 12 months.
severe_hypoglycemia_exclusion.rationale: Standard exclusion for insulin-titration studies; threshold aligned with ADA hypoglycemia classification.

hba1c_upper_bound_exclusion.clause_text: Have an HbA1c value greater than 10.5% at screening, suggesting clinically uncontrolled diabetes requiring more intensive intervention than this study can safely provide.
hba1c_upper_bound_exclusion.rationale: Patients above 10.5% require rapid intervention; ethical to exclude from a comparative trial.

cardiovascular_history_exclusion.clause_text: Have experienced any of the following within 6 months prior to screening: myocardial infarction, unstable angina, coronary revascularization, stroke, or transient ischemic attack.
cardiovascular_history_exclusion.rationale: Standard cardiovascular safety exclusion window for diabetes Phase III studies; aligned with FDA guidance for glucose-lowering agents.

renal_function_inclusion.clause_text: Have an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of at least 45 mL/min/1.73 m² at screening, calculated by the CKD-EPI equation.
renal_function_inclusion.rationale: eGFR ≥45 is a common threshold for insulin studies; CKD-EPI is the current standard equation.

pregnancy_contraception_requirement.clause_text: Women of childbearing potential must agree to use a highly effective method of contraception (Pearl Index <1) from screening through 30 days after the last dose of study drug. Men with female partners of childbearing potential must agree to use barrier contraception during the same period.
pregnancy_contraception_requirement.rationale: Standard ICH M3 contraception requirement; the language meets EMA and FDA expectations for chronic-treatment Phase III studies.

age_eligibility.clause_text: Be between 18 and 75 years of age, inclusive, at the time of screening.
age_eligibility.rationale: A defined age range (18–75) is standard for Phase III T2DM trials, capturing the adult population while excluding paediatric and very elderly subgroups with distinct risk profiles.

hba1c_inclusion_range.clause_text: Have an HbA1c of 7.0% to 10.5% (inclusive) at screening, measured by the central laboratory.
hba1c_inclusion_range.rationale: A 7.0–10.5% HbA1c window selects inadequately-controlled but not acutely uncontrolled T2DM patients, the appropriate population for a comparative glucose-lowering trial.

bmi_eligibility.clause_text: Have a body mass index (BMI) of 18.5 to 40.0 kg/m², inclusive, at screening.
bmi_eligibility.rationale: A BMI range of 18.5–40.0 kg/m² captures the dominant T2DM phenotype across US and Brazil while excluding underweight and class III obesity, where insulin pharmacokinetics differ substantially.

background_antidiabetic_therapy.clause_text: Be either drug-naïve or on a stable dose of metformin monotherapy (≥1500 mg/day for ≥12 weeks prior to screening), with no other antidiabetic agents.
background_antidiabetic_therapy.rationale: Specifying permitted background therapy (drug-naïve or stable metformin) defines a homogeneous baseline population and stabilises screen-failure rates.
